changelog:
- Initial release of the Perplexity skill.
- Enables AI-powered web search with grounded answers and citations via the Perplexity API.
- Supports both single and batch search queries.
- Requires a PERPLEXITY_API_KEY environment variable.
- Option to output raw JSON responses.
summary: Search the web with AI-powered answers via Perplexity API. Returns grounded responses with citations. Supports batch queries.
